name: Blue Moon
description: Blue Moon helps people find, create, join, and share local events for cleanups, food help, community gardens, tree planting, and neighborhood support.
license: Open-source project; see repository files for the final project license.

events.title: Santa Monica Beach Cleanup
events.summary: A relaxed Saturday cleanup near Tower 24. Bags and gloves are provided; bring water and sun protection.
events.bring: Water, sunscreen, closed-toe shoes, and a hat.
events.imageAlt: Volunteers sorting trash collected during a beach cleanup.

events.title: Echo Park Garden Morning
events.summary: Help weed, mulch, and prep two shared beds for summer vegetables.
events.bring: Reusable water bottle, clothes that can get dirty, and garden gloves if you have them.
events.imageAlt: A volunteer gardening in a sunny green space.

events.title: Venice Food Pantry Pack
events.summary: Pack pantry bags for Friday distribution. Come for the whole shift or the first hour.
events.bring: Comfortable shoes and a light jacket.
events.imageAlt: Volunteers carrying boxes for food distribution.

events.title: Palisades Park Cleanup
events.summary: A completed cleanup with photos and a simple impact note.
events.impactMetric: 14 people joined; 9 bags collected; 2 hours outside
events.proofSummary: The group filled nine bags, cleared the overlook path, and left the park visibly cleaner before the morning crowds arrived.
events.imageAlt: Volunteers cleaning a park with blue trash bags.
